title.en: Drag a Box and See Its IoU

brief.zh: 在照片上调整自己的矩形，与 YOLOX 给出的参考框比较。
brief.en: Adjust your rectangle over the photo and compare it with YOLOX's reference box.

concept.zh: 两个框相交的面积越接近它们的总覆盖面积，交并比越大。
concept.en: IoU increases as the overlapping area approaches the total area the two boxes cover.

hints.zh: 试试让你的框覆盖整张图，再把边缘收紧。比较两次数字。
hints.en: Try covering the whole photo, then bring the edges in. Compare the two scores.

prompt.zh: 在图上拖一个框。比较位置或大小变化前后的交并比。
prompt.en: Drag a box on the photo. Compare IoU before and after changing the position or size.
